detail.title: 4CH Penta-brid 4K Value/5MP Smart 1U 1SSD 1TB WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR5104C-4KL-I3(1T) 4CH Penta-brid 4K Value/5MP Smart 1U 1SSD 1TB WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • Preinstall 1TB SSD • 4-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 4K@15fps/5MP@25fps Encoding Capability • Max. 8-ch IP Video Input (Up to 8MP) • AI Functions: 2-ch QuickPick 2.0, 2-ch FR, 4-ch Perimeter Protection, 1-ch EPTZ, 1-ch Privacy Protection, 4-ch SMD, 4-ch AI Coding Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Perimeter Protection.Perimeter Performance AI by Recorder (Nu: Advanced Model: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel General Model: 4 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel

Face Detection.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 channels (up to 8 face images/s each channel)

Face Recognition.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 20,000 face images in total.

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 4 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle , reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 8 channels of IPC access 4 IP channels by default + 4 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 64 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 64 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 64 Mbps *After IP extension is enabled, the AI Function (IVS, SMD, FACE) will be disabled.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Main stream: 4K@(1 fps-7 fps); 6 MP@(1 fps-10 fps); 5 MP@(1 fps-12 fps); 4K-N, 4 MP, 3 MP@(1 fps-15 fps); 4M-N, 1080p, 720p, 960H, D1,CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps); Sub stream: 960H@(1 fps–15 fps); D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps)
Audio and Video.Video Output: 1 HDMI, 1 VGA HDMI: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 VGA: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 *Simultaneous/heterogeneous video sources output for VGA and HDMI is configurable
Audio and Video.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: ONVIF; Panasonic; Sony; Axis; Arecont; Samsung

Compression Standard.Video Compression: AI Coding; Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; FTP; DDNS; Alarm Server; P2P; Auto Registration; IP Search (Supports IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.)
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 22.12(Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK

Recording Playback.Record Mode: General; motion detection; intelligent; alarm; POS
Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback; general playback; event playback; tag playback; smart playback (face and motion detection)

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alar
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict) ;video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); IPC external alarm output; voice prompt; buzzer; log; preset; email

Ports.Two-way Talk: Yes (share the same audio input with the first channel)
Ports.HDD Interface: 1 SSD: 1TB (replaceable with 256 GB or 512 GB ) Stores for 18 days under default settings
